items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: I worked with him when he was with ABC, he was the musical director for Dick Cavett.

ctx.x: You had Frank Foster here. These are all dear friends of mine. You had Bobby Rosengarden. I worked with him when he was with ABC, he was the musical director for Dick Cavett. I had a great life in New York and these guys have never forgotten me and I’ve never forgotten them.
Well that is a good story. Your life’s a good story.
